risk
of
chronic

as
heart
disease
and
stroke

obesity
,
diabetes
and
some
forms
of
cancer
.

National
Physical
Activity
Guidelines
for
Adults

at
least
30
minutes
of
moderate
-
intensity
physical
activity
,
preferably
every

of

week
